description: Image Description: The image displays two folding knives placed on a textured fabric surface, likely a piece of tactical or military-style clothing. Both knives feature black handles with a textured grip pattern and silver blades with a satin finish. The top knife has a straight-edged blade with a circular hole near the base for opening, while the bottom knife has a partially serrated edge near the tip and a similar circular hole. Each handle is secured with visible screws and includes a thumb stud for easy one-handed deployment.
